name: epistemic-protocols
description: A domain-free metalanguage of structured types and morphisms for human-AI collaboration: it reduces cognitive load by eliciting unknowns into utterance, constraining AI attention without bias, and resolving interaction deficits at their root within bounded loops before local misalignment hardens into system-wide rework.

plugins.name: syneidesis
plugins.description: Surface potential gaps at decision points — /gap (συνείδησις: knowing-together)

plugins.name: katalepsis
plugins.description: Verify understanding of a result or artifact through intent-scented entry points — /grasp (κατάληψις: a grasping firmly)

plugins.name: aitesis
plugins.description: Infer context insufficiency before execution — /inquire (αἴτησις: a requesting)

plugins.name: analogia
plugins.description: Validate structural mapping between domains — /ground (ἀναλογία: a proportion)

plugins.name: periagoge
plugins.description: Align concrete cases first, then name what they share — /induce (περιαγωγή: turning-around)

plugins.name: euporia
plugins.description: Resolve via Extended-Mind reverse induction — /elicit (εὐπορία: way through)

plugins.name: merismos
plugins.description: Apportion an autonomous goal into coarse execution units and derive each unit's completion conditions — /apportion (μερισμός: an apportionment)

plugins.name: epharmoge
plugins.description: Detect application-context mismatch after execution — /contextualize (ἐφαρμογή: an application)

plugins.name: elenchus
plugins.description: Vet working context by dialectical antithesis before action — /sublate (ἔλεγχος: cross-examination)

plugins.name: horismos
plugins.description: Define epistemic boundaries per decision — /bound (ὁρισμός: a bounding)

plugins.name: epistemic-cooperative
plugins.description: Utility skills layered on top of the core protocols. /catalog browses the protocol handbook; each utility skill's own SKILL.md carries its contract.

plugins.name: anamnesis
plugins.description: Resolve vague recall into recognized context — /recollect (ἀνάμνησις: recollection)

plugins.name: anagoge
plugins.description: Elevate a vague recall to a higher-granularity unit — /ascend (ἀναγωγή: a leading-up)

plugins.name: hyphegesis
plugins.description: Conduct the method of a session's epistemic work before object-level cognition — /conduct (ὑφήγησις: a leading-the-way)

plugins.name: proplasma
plugins.description: Expose direction unknowns through divergent-discard instantiation before commitment — /preview (πρόπλασμα: a preliminary clay model)

plugins.name: heuresis
plugins.description: Widen an underexpanded candidate field through frame-parallel divergent generation — /ideate (εὕρεσις: finding/invention)

plugins.name: route
plugins.description: Route the accumulated session context to the core protocol whose deficit it shows — /route (per-prompt hook directive)
